title: zirinium
description: 1.8.9 bedwars or pvp pack, recolored in a purple palette!
body:
[catinium](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/catinium/gallery) in the [zir16x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/zir16x) color palette! includes most common blocks

![A screenshot with minecraft armor sets, tools, and various utility items and ores.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/eGfSyWdx/images/c64fb4dcd628ee54364c0dbb86d1ed9cfc3ea6bc.png)

this pack is a **work in progress** and has eventual planned updates! again unlikely to be updated to modern due to the amount of textures needed unfortunately
